notes.title: Major update Version 1.10.4
notes.notes:
Welcome back toasters!

A lot of the work for this update was a preparation for the steam release 



Additions


 Added A POM based fur shader to characters
 Added CTF Flag as a melee weapon
 Added Cheese as a weapon 
 Added new character voice lines by: Chase
 Skybox enhancements to all levels
 Added photo mode
 Player management menu now has the ability to grant weapons
 Some game modes will now use a more grounded movement
 Added new cheese achievements
 Added a new shooting range level
 Added a cheese game mode
 Added Lumen global illumination as a graphics option
 Added Assault as a new game mode
 Added TDM Assault as a new game mode



Removals


 Removed CTF Game mode
 Removed toon Post processing effect
 Removed replay mode
 Removed extra modes from voting console


Cosmetics


 Added new cosmetic eye options
 Added new chest cosmetic options by : Bruhvv
 Added CAWU as an override cosmetic by : Bruhvv


Changes


 Major optimizations towards CPU and GPU usage
 Major UI Updates by : Unselles
 Changed how the first person body is rendered
 Updated wall grab animations
 A pickup sound will now play when grabbing a weapon
 Updated character textures and meshes
 Balancing changes to corruption game mode
 Updates and changes to different levels
 Tons of weapon balance changes
 QOL improvements to game modes




Bug Fixes


 Fixed rendering issues with control points game mode
 Fixed issues with ragdoll physical animation not playing properly
 Fixed some issues that prevented multiplayer lobbies from working properly
 Fixed some rendering issues on the chat box
 Fixed issues with emotes not removing props
 Fixed UI sounds to use volume settings
 Quick melee input issues have been fully fixed
 Tons of QA improvements
 Fixed broken character facial expressions
 Typo corrections across multiple UI entries




Notes
Game will crash when using the emote box emote

Fixed wrong names on music tracks
